book_tape.late_start_boundary: The 09:26 ET start cannot prove the preregistered 09:25 full-session prefix, but it precedes every possible warmed v3 RTH admission in this run.

causal_projection.source_state: paired_equity research latest_position, requiring exact research/broker state agreement
causal_projection.entry_rule: At a fresh post-start RTH target transition, buy its mapped ETF at the first full-depth executable ask available at the decision clock; derive quantity from that ask.
causal_projection.exit_rule: Sell the held ETF at the first full-depth executable bid when the target changes, becomes flat, or the normal selected runtime reaches its 15:57 ET liquidation boundary.
causal_projection.flip_rule: Sell on the first checkpoint and permit the new buy no earlier than the next ordinary checkpoint; strict settled cash may block it.

fixed_realistic.label: actual-current Fixed counterfactual
fixed_realistic.authority: frozen measured schedule corroborated by July 29 broker what-if

tiered_conditional.label: conditional Tiered counterfactual; never realized unless the broker proves Tiered effective

boundaries: This projection measures transport economics only and cannot change v3 direction, admission, state ownership, sizing policy, or execution authority.
The same executable prices are used for Fixed and Tiered; only the fee schedule differs.
An open mark is not realized profit.
A profitable counterfactual does not select the transport or start the live profitability clock.
Tomorrow's fresh Tiered broker preview and an explicit RTH-first scope acceptance remain independently required.
